description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'AppointmentDetailScreen' that displays detailed information about a specific appointment. It uses the Provider package for state management, fetching appointment data by ID and displaying appointment status, start time, doctor info, and notes, with loading indicator handling.

classes.name: AppointmentDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that shows details of an appointment based on an ID, fetching data via Provider and displaying status, start time, doctor, and notes, with loading handling.
